thesis: Tyson Foods, Inc. memiliki fundamental lemah (skor 46/100) dengan keunggulan utama di valuasi (67) dan pertumbuhan (55). Titik lemahnya ada di kualitas bisnis (17). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $82.59 — potensi naik 37.4% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal cukup (51/100). Risiko geopolitik sedang, terutama dari tema Perang Dagang & Tarif; berpeluang diuntungkan tema Rusia–Ukraina & Belanja Pertahanan.

cons.text: Lonjakan laba sangat besar (+137%) — bila bisnisnya siklikal, P/E rendah di puncak siklus bisa menyesatkan; proyeksi berisiko terlalu optimistis.
Rentan terhadap tema Perang Dagang & Tarif (intensitas 64/100, eksposur -0.5 dari skala -1 s.d. +1).
Payout ratio 125% — dividen melebihi laba, keberlanjutan perlu dicermati.
Estimasi nilai wajar antar-metode berbeda jauh — ketidakpastian proyeksi tinggi.

pros.text: Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 137% — dari $1.62 ke $3.84.
PEG ratio 0.26 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).
Estimasi nilai wajar $82.59 vs harga $60.10 — potensi naik 37% (rentang $59–$114).
Free cash flow yield 5.5%: setiap $100 nilai saham menghasilkan $5.5 kas bebas per tahun ($1.2 M).

Diuntungkan tema geopolitik Rusia–Ukraina & Belanja Pertahanan (intensitas 45/100): Perang di Eropa Timur mendorong anggaran pertahanan NATO, keamanan energi, dan harga komoditas (gas, pupuk, gandum).

summary: Tyson Foods, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a food company worldwide. It operates through four segments: Beef, Pork, Chicken, and Prepared Foods. The company processes live fed cattle and hogs; fabricates dressed beef and pork carcasses into primal and sub-primal meat cuts, as well as case ready beef and pork, and fully cooked meats; raises and processes chickens into fresh, frozen, and value-added chicken products, including breaded chicken strips, nuggets, patties, and other ready-to-fix or fully cooked chicken parts; and supplies poultry breeding stock.
